title: Shiva Panchakshara Stotram Lyrics with Meaning in English: Verse 6
desc: Shiva Panchakshara Stotram verse with Sanskrit text and a simple English meaning. Chant on Mondays and Maha Shivaratri.
alt: Lord Shiva, Shiva Panchakshara Stotram with English meaning
caption: Shiva Panchakshara Stotram: one verse with its meaning.
intro: **Shiva Panchakshara Stotram** is among the most loved Shiva hymns. This post gives one verse in Sanskrit with its **meaning in simple English**.
takeaways: Mondays and Pradosham are the usual days for Shiva stotras.
Bilva leaves, water and a lamp are the simple offerings.
Understand the meaning and the chant becomes prayer.

p: **पञ्चाक्षरमिदं पुण्यं यः पठेच्छिवसन्निधौ ।** **शिवलोकमवाप्नोति शिवेन सह मोदते ॥**
This Panchakshara Stotram gives merit. One who recites it in the presence of Shiva reaches the world of Shiva and rejoices with him.
Sit quietly, take three slow breaths and chant the verse once aloud, then once in the mind. Do the whole hymn on Mondays, one verse on other days.

faq.q: What is the meaning of this Shiva Panchakshara Stotram verse?
faq.a: This Panchakshara Stotram gives merit. One who recites it in the presence of Shiva reaches the world of Shiva and rejoices with him.

faq.q: When should I chant Shiva stotras?
faq.a: **Mondays**, **Pradosham** and **Maha Shivaratri** are the traditional times.

note: The Sanskrit is the traditional text. The English is our own plain rendering.
